mission: A network of small scientific facilities wants one reusable instrument or procedure that can turn existing computation and measurements into new, independently checkable results. There is a shared CPU and access to public source records. Private facility data, an instrument reservation, paid inference, and operator adoption would each require separate permission. Discover up to five genuinely different beneficiary-specific possibilities; you may combine areas, invent another route, or present a hypothesis without a supporting source. Choose the first experiment worth building and the condition that would make you abandon it.
instructions: Use only the supplied primary records. In each entry distinguish what a source establishes from what you propose to construct. Cite exact short source phrases if applicable. A genuine new possibility may remain unverified. Compare a competent incumbent on the same complete outcome. Choose your own inventions, actions and tests. Do not infer historical impossibility, demand, field performance, profit or physical permission.
